summary: Frontend-only regression for 3 merchant UI cleanup changes. All 3 targeted changes verified PASS on both desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844): (1) 'Top Customers' removed from desktop sidebar and mobile 'More' sheet, (2) 'Network Tree' tab/toggle fully removed from My Network module (network-module renders members list + stats + toolbar cleanly, no 'Network Tree' text or button), (3) inner duplicate <h1> removed from My Network and Service Reminders modules — exactly one 'My Network' H1 and one 'Service Reminders' H1 visible (both come from PanelLayout's canonical section header). Regression check: My Customers, Wallet, Analytics, My Invoices, Commission (nav-earnings) modules all open without runtime errors.

issues: Recharts container prints repeated warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'. Not a regression from this session, but should be fixed by adding minWidth/minHeight or fixed aspect to ResponsiveContainer parents.

React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' originating from /app/frontend/src/pages/merchant/NetworkParts.jsx line ~60 (the <option> for page-size 10). A <span> is being rendered inside <option>; browsers may render it but React warns. Pre-existing, unrelated to this session's 3 cleanup changes.

action_items: (Low) Clean up NetworkParts.jsx page-size <option>: remove the inline <span>/wrapper so option children are plain text to remove the hydration warning.
(Low) Give Recharts ResponsiveContainer parents an explicit height (or set aspect) to remove width(-1)/height(-1) warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: The 3 requested cleanups look correct in the DOM: only the canonical PanelLayout section header renders the section title, and no duplicate inner <h1> was found in My Network or Service Reminders.
Nav registry no longer contains a 'topcustomers' entry — good; matches both desktop sidebar and mobile More sheet.
Note: The 'Commission' menu uses data-testid='nav-earnings' (label 'Commission'). If tests/docs elsewhere expect data-testid='nav-commission', consider standardising.
